meta_description: New Design is your trusted painter and decorator in Manchester. Interior and exterior painting, decorating, and colour consultancy. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting that revitalises your home or business, completed on time and within budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: From interior wall finishes to exterior repainting and bespoke colour schemes, we handle every detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh living spaces with expert preparation, primer, and finish coats. We colour-match and offer advice on trending palettes to suit your style.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior work including woodwork, render, and masonry. We use premium exterior paints that protect against Manchester's elements.

services.title: Colour Consultancy & Design
services.desc: Unsure what colour scheme works? We provide professional colour advice and mood boards to help you visualise the finished result before any brush touches paint.

services.title: Commercial & Office Redecorating
services.desc: Minimal disruption scheduling for offices and retail spaces. We work around your business hours and leave sites clean and ready to use.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, ceilings, and fitted furniture painted and stained to a high finish. All surfaces properly prepared for long-lasting results.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Bespoke wallpaper installation and feature wall creation. Whether textured, patterned, or accent-coloured, we ensure seamless application and perfect alignment.

about_pullquote: We treat every room like it's our own home—that's the standard.
about_para_1: New Design was founded on the principle that painting and decorating should be reliable, transparent, and leave your space transformed. With over 15 years' experience across Manchester's homes and commercial properties, we've built a reputation for meticulous preparation, attention to detail, and honest pricing. Every project—whether a single bedroom or a whole office—receives the same level of care and professionalism.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we listen, communicate clearly throughout the job, and deliver exactly what we promise. We pride ourselves on leaving sites immaculate and finishing on schedule. Whether you need a complete redecoration or specialist colour advice, you'll work with friendly, skilled professionals who understand that your space matters.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: New Design repainted our lounge and hallway during lockdown. The team was tidy, professional, and finished two days early. They colour-matched the existing woodwork perfectly without us asking. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text: Had our entire house exterior done before winter. Really impressed with the prep work—they didn't cut corners. Paint is holding up brilliantly and the quote they gave matched the final bill exactly. No surprises.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Small bedroom refresh, but they made it feel like a complete transformation. The colour consultant helped us pick something we'd never have chosen ourselves and it's perfect. Will definitely use again for the rest of the house.
reviews.author: Sophie K.
